title: Natural Blueberry Gelatin
excerpt: Learn to make a delicious natural blueberry gelatin, made with real fruit, with no artificial colors or flavors. A refreshing, light dessert to enjoy at home.
imageAlt: Crystal glasses with deep purple natural blueberry gelatin, decorated with whole blueberries.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons bee honey or sweetener, to taste

steps: In a small bowl, sprinkle the unflavored gelatin over the 1/4 cup of cold water and let it rest for 5 minutes to hydrate.

In a pot over medium heat, cook the Fresh Pick blueberries with the 1 1/2 cups of water and the honey for 5 minutes, until they come to a boil and soften. These high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca will release all their color and natural sweetness.
Remove the pot from the heat and move the mixture to the blender. Add the teaspoon of lemon juice and blend very well on medium speed.
Strain the mixture over a bowl if you prefer a completely smooth texture, or leave the bits of fiber in if you like it more rustic.
Add the hydrated gelatin to the still-hot mixture and stir with a hand whisk until it dissolves completely.
Pour the liquid into four glasses or individual molds, let it rest at room temperature and then refrigerate for at least 3 hours until completely set.
tips: You can add a few whole Fresh Pick blueberries at the bottom of the molds before pouring in the liquid so you find surprises of fresh fruit in every spoonful.
Keep your gelatins in the fridge covered with plastic wrap so they don’t absorb odors from other foods; they will stay fresh and delicious for up to 5 days.
